mechanism: A motif the local lexicon does not contain is never searched for, and the not-searched result is read as zero contribution.
control: A shared union lexicon within each model/readout; not-searched encoded explicitly.

mechanism: Near-duplicate CWMs are counted twice, or one coefficient is split between them.
control: A family/variant ontology; merged-versus-split sensitivity analysis.

mechanism: Short overlaps and offset maximisation manufacture spuriously high similarity.
control: Two-sided overlap; null calibration; PPM and CWM scored on the same window.

mechanism: The top database hit is read as a specific TF identity.
control: Keep family separate from putative TF; carry source and confidence fields.

mechanism: Raw contribution units are not comparable across models.
control: Estimate the effect within each model; meta-analyse at a second level.

mechanism: The same peaks serve as both discovery and validation set.
control: Held-out chromosome, cross-fitting, or external data.

mechanism: Multiple instances within one peak are treated as independent samples.
control: Peak-level aggregation, or a cluster-robust bootstrap.

mechanism: lambda, FIMO p, trimming and lexicon tier each move the conclusion.
control: Multiverse / specification curve.

mechanism: family, variant, pair and method are tested at the same time.
control: Three layers that may not substitute for one another: the primary family tests use hierarchical FDR, the test count is fixed at freeze time, and sensitivity analyses may not be folded in afterwards; a specification grid gets no per-cell BH but reports the specification curve's joint null distribution (§9.6); the output mode of a peak-set query is determined by its selection source (§9.8).

mechanism: no sequence, no hit, not searched and low score are collapsed into one zero.
control: Multi-state encoding and a two-part model.

mechanism: An index that is only meaningful inside one local namespace is used across a boundary, and the evidence is filed against the wrong motif or peak.
control: Explicit translation tables that raise on unknown keys; no parsing of semantics out of a key string; tests assert the identity of the object retrieved.

mechanism: Metacluster formation carries an absolute seqlet-count gate. The same model can form a negative metacluster genome-wide and fail to form one on a cluster-split subset. The size gate is the proximate mechanism; whether the per-peak rate is also the same must be measured, not assumed.
control: When discovery is run per cluster, lexicon composition varies systematically with cluster size; report per-peak rates rather than presence/absence alone, and check subset size before comparing across clusters. Where the rate is measured to differ, an absence may not be attributed to too few peaks; record UNEXPLAINED until the ultimate cause is proven to the exclusion of the alternatives.

mechanism: The same sequence element can be assigned to opposite metaclusters at different readout widths; sign is a property of the model-and-readout pair, not necessarily of the element.
control: The positive/negative separation rule holds within a single readout; verify explicitly before comparing signs across readouts.

mechanism: The hit caller's discrete output moves with input scale; the same peak can be retained in one run and dropped in another of different scale.
control: One full-universe run shared by every specification; no re-running the caller between specifications; input scale carried with every result as a provenance field.

mechanism: A short motif picks up a database match and a biological family name at chance level, then dominates a layer through a very high retention rate.
control: Three flag rules, on length, q and seqlet count; the chance-occurrence expectation reported beside the observed retention rate; flagged variants appear by variant_id only.

mechanism: If the criterion that selected the peak set came from the same signal being measured, the inference can be statistically valid and semantically circular.
control: The provenance grade determines the output mode; clustering on attribution-derived features is graded SUBSTRATE_CIRCULAR; splitting is block-level and precedes clustering.

mechanism: A library default (a pivot aggregation, say) silently turns an all-missing group into zero, so a four-state encoding already written down is bypassed at table-building time.
control: An explicit sentinel for undefined values; an executable assertion against zero-filling; coverage computed before any fill.

mechanism: When a previous result is used as a gate or a comparator baseline, that result's own defect transfers into the current decision as bias.
control: The comparator is labelled with its basis and its source; a gate cites the source table's path and column, never a rounded interval quoted from prose.

mechanism: One stratifying variable is generated by different rules in different subsets, so the interaction term absorbs a definitional difference that cannot be separated from a real between-group difference.
control: The main analysis uses one set of definitions for every cell; any second set is a separately named sensitivity comparison only. Produce the stratum cross-tabulation before looking at any effect.

mechanism: Below an adequate sample size or event count, a result whose interval is wide enough to be uninformative is written up as a directional conclusion, indistinguishable from a direction that was actually measured.
control: A pre-registered sample-size floor; when the interval contains both zero and the reference point estimate, record NOT_ESTIMABLE_UNDERPOWERED and record no direction.
